name: omh-sales-pipeline-review
works_with: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, opencode, OpenClaw and pi, or Hermes Agent with oh-my-hermes
short: Give it a CRM export and it writes a pipeline health, forecast and follow-up review that cites the records behind each finding.
what: A workflow skill from oh-my-hermes for sales pipeline reviews. You supply a CRM export or pipeline snapshot, and it checks the as-of time, currency, stage and amount definitions, duplicates and owners before any figure. Then it reviews deal health, stale and slipped deals, forecast scenarios and calibration against past forecasts, and hands off follow-ups with owners and due dates. It proposes CRM corrections but never makes them.
who: Sales leaders and business owners who run a recurring pipeline or forecast review from exports. It is for the whole portfolio. For one account's discovery or outreach the skill points you to a different OMH skill.
needs: A coding agent that supports skills
A pipeline snapshot with its as-of time, plus your currency, amount, stage and forecast definitions
For calibration: prior forecasts, actuals and the quota or target

steps.title: Run your agent's installer from your project
steps.text: Replace `.cursor` with `.claude`, `.codex`, `.opencode`, `.openclaw` or `.pi`. Add `--user` to install for every project instead.

steps.title: Ask for a review
steps.text: Phrases like "sales pipeline review", "pipeline health" or "deal review" trigger it. Attach the export and say when it was taken.

try.label: From the SKILL.md
try.text: "Here is this week's pipeline export as of Monday 09:00; review deal health, slipped close dates, and whether the commit forecast holds up against last quarter's calls."

watch: The installer adds OMH's whole workflow catalog, not only this skill. A reinstall replaces any `SKILL.md` you edited.
If the as-of time, stage definitions, currency basis or owners are missing, it stops with `HOLD` and asks rather than computing on partial data.
With only one snapshot, stage movement and slipped close dates come back as unavailable.
It does not change CRM records or send alerts. Corrections stay proposals, and raw export rows are not kept in its saved outputs unless you approve it.
